Values in the database that look odd. **They are used as reported**; nothing has been changed or removed. This list only asks whether they are right. The same list is in `outputs/tables/QUESTIONS_for_data_providers.xlsx`.

```{r}
q <- read.csv("../outputs/tables/QUESTIONS_for_data_providers.csv")
for (t in unique(q$topic)) {
  cat("")
  print(knitr::kable(q[q$topic == t, c("where", "question")], row.names = FALSE, caption = t))
}
```
